summary: Tested the painted portraits on the backend and frontend. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass. The portrait is saved and returned, invalid, empty, missing or path-traversal values fall back to golden-willow, a legacy record with no portrait (8kkfvndb) returns golden-willow, and card.jpg?v=14 is a 1080x1920 JPEG for all 5 existing ids, with a different oval for each. Frontend: portrait selection is deterministic for all 5 answer sets. Meet at 390 and 1280 shows the painting clipped by the oval, with no K-* ids, and the bands, heart and ribbon drawn after (above) the figure. Tapping adds mk-glow and mk-hearts. The 'breathing' class is present and is removed under reduced motion. The desktop strand 1-9 reveal rises monotonically 600->407 and never resets, in sepia (weave opacity 1). Strand 10 shows the suitor check instead. Weaving starts at 600, rises to 30, then blooms to colour (weave 1->0) and goes to Meet. The share card shows the matching -bg painting, the mp4 video download works, /card?frames gives 3 frames, /h matches the portrait, and the full UI flow from the intro veil to Meet with the must-haves checklist works. Suitor cards have no portrait images. Main issues: on Bands the face/bloom animation never plays (instant colour), and the moorland-scholar colour painting is almost greyscale.

ui_bugs.issue: On desktop, arriving from strand 9->10->/bands, the medallion is already at reveal y=30 with img-weave opacity 0 on its first rendered frame. The face does not weave in and the colours do not bloom; he just appears in full colour. On phones there is never a growth/bloom on Bands, because lastStrands is null (no desktop panel). The end state is correct.

issues: moorland-scholar.webp (the colour image) is almost greyscale: mean HSV saturation is 52, against about 205-238 for the other four and 123 for its own -weave sepia. When he 'blooms into true colours' he gets greyer, and on Meet he looks like an un-bloomed stone/grey statue. Recolour the portrait, or accept that this one has a weak bloom.
The legacy band line shows a lone 'REMEMBERS' label (old data). Cosmetic only.

action_items: Fix the missing face weave-in/bloom on /bands. Likely RCA: React.StrictMode (dev) double-invokes layout effects. The `root.current.innerHTML = html` effect runs again and swaps in a fresh SVG (no rect.dataset.y), while module-level `lastStrands` was already set to 10 by the first pass. So on the second pass grow=false, and the face and colour are applied instantly. Make the innerHTML effect idempotent (e.g. skip if root already has children, or set it via dangerouslySetInnerHTML/useState), or record lastStrands outside the layout effect. Also decide what phones should do on Bands, where lastStrands is null (e.g. start from LEVELS[9])
Recolour moorland-scholar.webp (and -bg/base layer if needed) so his 'true colours' are actually warmer and more colourful than the sepia weave state
critical_code_review_comments: Medallion.jsx: the module-level `lastStrands` is shared global state mutated inside a layout effect. It is fragile under StrictMode/concurrent re-renders and across several medallions on a page
Medallion.jsx: imperative innerHTML + querySelector inside layout effects; the double-run in dev resets the DOM (see the action item)

rca of the issue: Bands no-bloom: repro on desktop 1280x800: inject answers, /strand/9 -> next-musts-button -> weave-him-musts-button -> /bands, then poll [id$=img-weave] opacity every 60ms. The first frame with the medallion already shows y=30 and opacity 0. Expected: grow from LEVELS[9]=407 to 30 with weave 1->0 after 0.7s. Probable cause: StrictMode's double layout-effect run (see the action item).
